prose: Kerri Hummingbird joins Vibe Rant to discuss her new book, Inner Medicine. As the host of the Soul Nectar show, an energy worker and shamanic teacher, Kerri provides guidance for the path of the healers and whole-ness keepers. Owl-master Gordan Hamil will also be on board tonight to add his insights to our talk about connecting to the land and the four directions.
